Guide & Academy/BA Lending Academy/Module 11

Module 11 of 15

The lending term set

A working vocabulary for every facility, security, cash flow and lifecycle state in the 21 journeys.

Journey analysis fails when familiar words hide different legal or accounting meanings. This module teaches the shared term system before the per-journey deep dives, so a BA can compare products precisely and map each term to facts, evidence and events.

6 lessons132 min guided timeComplete in sequence

Lesson 11.1 · 22 min

Facilities, limits and drawdowns

  • Distinguish term, demand and revolving facilities
  • Explain limit, drawing power and availability
  • Model drawdown, renewal and expiry

Lesson 11.2 · 22 min

Security, collateral and credit support

  • Separate security from the financed asset
  • Distinguish pledge, hypothecation, mortgage and assignment
  • Explain guarantees, margin and LTV

Lesson 11.3 · 22 min

Cash-flow and pricing vocabulary

  • Distinguish principal, interest, fee and charge
  • Compare reducing, flat, fixed and floating rate
  • Read APR and schedule terms correctly

Lesson 11.4 · 22 min

Working-capital and trade-finance vocabulary

  • Explain receivable, inventory and purchase-order finance
  • Distinguish invoice discounting, factoring and supply-chain finance
  • Map trade instruments to contingent and funded exposure

Lesson 11.5 · 22 min

Delinquency, asset quality and resolution vocabulary

  • Separate due, overdue, DPD, SMA and NPA
  • Distinguish restructure, settlement and write-off
  • Explain cure, closure and recovery

Lesson 11.6 · 22 min

Control, evidence and decision vocabulary

  • Use fact, evidence, decision and event precisely
  • Distinguish maker-checker, override, waiver and exception
  • Specify lineage and replay
